name: NY 5-min trend continuation: close beyond the prior 5-min bar on a straight session, with its move
why: Founder 2026-10-19 (5-min setup, 1-min entry study): on a straight NY session the institutions repositioning keep pushing; each new 5-min high (low) in the session direction is them adding, and short-term faders are forced to cover. The 5-min study showed a small era-stable gross edge (+0.05 R) that a 5-min-bar stop cannot pay costs on; this gives each trade more room. Pre-registered in research/preregistered/2026-10-19_ema_9_14_cross_study.md.

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(px-open)/max(hod-lod,1) >= 0.55 && ((cl(5,1) > hi(5,2) && px > open) || (cl(5,1) < lo(5,2) && px < open))
